notes: Discovery navigation only. Zodiac picks which corner of the market to explore; it is never an input to any score. Each sign lists theme sectors; each sector has one or more sub-themes; each sub-theme lists universe tickers with an `angle` (shown on the card and used to keep the daily set varied). Company traits are curated heuristics for personal fit, not fundamentals.
